outcome: Admission to the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: 1,936 women with twin pregnancies delivered at ≥24 weeks' gestation at a tertiary academic hospital from 1995 to 2016
finding: Advanced maternal age in twin pregnancies was associated with an increased risk of gestational diabetes and placenta previa, and higher birth weight, but a lower rate of NICU admission.
birth_weight: Birth weight data was collected but specific values are not provided in the abstract
